summary: The note is a short biographical entry for Clive Hale, an Australian television news and current affairs presenter. It states he lived from 1937 to 5 June 2005 and worked for the Australian Broadcasting Corporation (ABC) for 38 years.
one_line: Clive Hale (1937–2005) was an Australian TV news and current affairs presenter who spent 38 years at the ABC.
key_facts: Clive Hale was born in 1937 and died on 5 June 2005.
Clive Hale was an Australian television news and current affairs presenter.
Clive Hale presented for the Australian Broadcasting Corporation (ABC).
Clive Hale worked at the Australian Broadcasting Corporation (ABC) for 38 years.
